business_requirements.name: Real-Time Inventory Integrity Monitoring
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall continuously monitor the integrity of the data link between store Point of Sale (POS) systems and the central platform to ensure data consistency.
business_requirements.business_objective: To maintain the accuracy of real-time inventory snapshots and prevent data divergence between store-level records and platform records.
business_requirements.business_value: Ensures the reliability of inventory data used for allocation, reduces customer complaints about unavailable items, and supports proactive intervention to prevent overselling.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The Information Requirement explicitly states the purpose is 'To monitor the integrity of the supply chain data' and lists 'Sync Latency' and 'Discrepancy Count' as required details.

origin.description: Data indicating the status of the data link between the store's Point of Sale (POS) and the platform, including latency, last sync time, and detected discrepancies.

success_measures.measure: Continuous monitoring coverage of all store partners
Latency thresholds defined for alert triggering
Immediate logging of discrepancies between POS and platform

policies_and_constraints: Sync health must be monitored continuously for all store partners.
Discrepancies between POS and platform must be logged immediately.
assumptions: Store Partner POS systems are capable of reporting sync status and discrepancies.
Platform Operator has access to real-time inventory snapshots from both sources.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Data divergence leading to overselling if monitoring fails.
Dependency: Availability of real-time inventory snapshots from Store Partner POS systems.

business_requirements.name: Automated Overselling Risk Prevention
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall detect and alert stakeholders to potential overselling risks early by analyzing synchronization latency and discrepancies.
business_requirements.business_objective: To enable proactive intervention before inventory data errors result in customer complaints or order fulfillment failures.
business_requirements.business_value: Reduces customer complaints about unavailable items, prevents revenue loss from overselling, and ensures the reliability of real-time inventory data used for allocation.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The Information Requirement states that monitoring enables 'proactive intervention to prevent overselling' and lists 'Discrepancy Count' as a required detail. This implies a business need to act on this data to prevent the specific risk of overselling.

origin.description: Data indicating the status of the data link between the store's Point of Sale (POS) and the platform, including latency, last sync time, and detected discrepancies.

success_measures.measure: Alerts triggered for detected overselling risks
Reduction in customer complaints regarding unavailable items

policies_and_constraints: Deciding whether to pause sales of specific items pending data reconciliation.
Triggering alerts to Store Partners to fix their POS integrations.
assumptions: Alert thresholds can be defined based on predefined rules.
Store Partners have the capability to fix their POS integrations upon notification.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Failure to detect discrepancies leads to overselling.
Dependency: Ability to pause sales of specific items pending reconciliation.

business_requirements.name: Dynamic Synchronization Frequency Adjustment
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall support dynamic adjustment of inventory synchronization frequency based on discrepancy rates and sync health metrics.
business_requirements.business_objective: To optimize network-wide visibility and resource utilization by adapting sync frequency to actual data integrity needs.
business_requirements.business_value: Ensures the reliability of real-time inventory data used for allocation while optimizing system resources and reducing unnecessary data transfer overhead.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The Information Requirement lists 'Adjusting the frequency of inventory synchronization based on discrepancy rates' as a business decision supported by the metrics. This implies a business need for the system to execute this adjustment logic.

origin.description: Data indicating the status of the data link between the store's Point of Sale (POS) and the platform, including latency, last sync time, and detected discrepancies.

success_measures.measure: Synchronization frequency adjusted based on discrepancy rates
Health metrics aggregated for network-wide visibility

policies_and_constraints: Health metrics must be aggregated for network-wide visibility.
Latency thresholds must be defined to trigger alerts.
assumptions: Discrepancy rates are a valid indicator for adjusting sync frequency.
System resources allow for dynamic frequency adjustment.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Over-adjustment leading to system instability or data inconsistency.
Dependency: Accurate calculation of discrepancy rates.

business_requirements.name: Technical Failure Alerting and Support
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall alert Store Partners and Support teams to technical failures in real-time inventory updates.
business_requirements.business_objective: To enable rapid resolution of technical failures in POS integrations that impact data integrity.
business_requirements.business_value: Reduces downtime of inventory updates, ensures the reliability of the supply chain data, and minimizes the impact of technical failures on order allocation.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The Information Requirement states the purpose includes 'alert staff to technical failures in real-time inventory updates' and lists 'Error Log' as a required detail. This implies a business need to notify stakeholders of these failures.
